desc: This Frigidaire 1.8 cu. ft. Over-The-Range Pocket Handle Microwave makes meal time easy with Sensor Cook Technology that automatically detects food and adjusts power levels and cooking times giving you great-tasting results. Plus, Convenient Preset Cooking options, and Quick Start buttons offer time savings so that you can put delicious meals on the table without all the extra effort.
hl: Microwave sensors detect and automatically adjust power levels and cooking times for a variety of items, providing great-tasting results every time.
Get meals on the table in minutes with six different Quick Start options that allow you to start cooking faster.
Offers a clear, bright view of your cooktop with bright LED lighting.
Monitor your food while it cooks with our bright interior LED lighting.
Easily upgrade the look of your kitchen with this sleek and functional pocket door handle.
Enjoy a seamless cooking experience with responsive capacitive touch button controls.
